Subject: Redline review + demo — aligning stakeholders and finding a slot

Hi Sarah / Ben —

Thanks again for the thoughtful redlines you shared yesterday. We reviewed Novus_Redlines_v3 and think it would be most productive to pair the contract discussion with a short, focused demo so your engineers can validate the technical bits while legal/procurement walk through the redlines.

Who from your side should join for the contract session? You mentioned procurement and security in the doc so I've cc'd the folks from our side who should be on the call:
- Diego (SE) — technical clarifications / demo snippets
- Marissa (legal ops) — contract-level clarifications / SOW language

Proposed approach: 30–40 minute session. First 15 minutes demo + tech Q&A, then 20–25 minutes focused on high-priority redlines (data residency, retention, audit logs). We can keep the rest as async if needed.

Available slots (Pacific):
- Mon Apr 5, 10:00–10:40 PT
- Mon Apr 5, 15:00–15:40 PT
- Tue Apr 6, 08:30–09:10 PT

If none of those work, share a couple of preferred windows and we’ll do our best to adapt. I’ll also attach the v3 redlines and a one-page mutual action plan so everyone has context.

Thanks —
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com]

Jonas —

- Ben Foster — Director of Engineering (will bring two platform engineers)
- Procurement (procurement@novushealth.com) — will be handling contract terms
- Security (security@novushealth.com) — to confirm controls and SOC-related asks

The time windows on Apr 5 are tight for Ben. We can do Tue Apr 6, 08:30 PT (that works best), or Wed Apr 7 after 11:00 PT. If you can confirm Tue 08:30, we’ll lock it.

Also — Ben uploaded a short list of clarifying questions into the doc (page 2). Please have Diego prepared to show the KV-cache behavior and the audit log export briefly.

—Sarah

Team —

I’ll prepare the demo snippets requested. Quick notes so we’re aligned on what I’ll show: 
- KV/prefix caching: quick live trace showing cache hit vs miss on repeated prompts (5 min)
- Audit logs: show the export UI and the raw JSON export; highlight fields (request_id, model_version, region, tokens_generated)
- Fallback behavior: show how we route to smaller model variant at high load and the graceful degradation policy

I have a small ask for Marissa: can you flag any redline items that explicitly require legal input on the call vs those we can answer immediately? That’ll help prioritize time.

Also added a short demo checklist to the Drive link Jonas shared.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2027-04-05T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novus — prep notes for demo + redline session

Diego / team —

I skimmed Novus_Redlines_v3 and highlighted three items that should absolutely be discussed live:
1) Data residency clause (Section 4.2) — can’t accept broad multi-region hosting without a written assurance on control plane access.
2) Retention & deletion SLA (Section 7) — need clarity on time to delete and verification path.
3) Audit log accessibility for third-party auditors (Section 11) — redline proposes a monthly export; we need to propose a secure export workflow.

Everything else looks like standard playbook items we can handle in follow-up threads. I’ll prepare suggested language for each bullet and bring it to the call. If Laura could be on for the first 10 minutes that’d help with any exec-level commercial asks.

—Marissa
Legal Ops | Redwood Inference

Thanks for arranging — the slot worked well. A few quick follow-ups from our side after the call and attachments:
- The team appreciated the KV cache trace — could you share the trace export as discussed?
- Procurement will send a short packet with our standard indemnity language; procurement@novushealth.com will attach it to the DocuSign envelope later today.
- Security requested the audit log JSON example you exported in the demo (redacted). If you can drop that into the shared Drive, we’ll validate fields.

We’ll also take Marissa’s suggested language offline and come back with any counter-questions. For next steps, can Jonas propose a timeline for: updated contract with agreed language, and a draft SOW with delivery milestones?

Appreciate the responsiveness —
Ben
